message.content: According to WolfgangSchulz's conversations, several places in Europe stand out as stunning to him. He mentions the fjords in Norway, the lavender fields in Provence, and the streets of Prague. Specifically, WolfgangSchulz shares, "The fjords in Norway are breathtaking, you can’t beat those views." Additionally, he highlights the lavender fields in Provence as being like a sea of purple and the charming old town of Prague. These places clearly leave a lasting impression on WolfgangSchulz during his travels through Europe.
